settings.repere: Texte · Some people notice a brief adjustment …
settings.text: Some people notice a brief adjustment period in the first 1 to 2 weeks as the concentrated formula begins clearing clogged pores and regulating oil production. Your skin may go through an initial clearing phase where existing congestion surfaces before settling, which is normal and typically resolves within 2 to 3 weeks. This is not a reaction. If anything feels off beyond 2 weeks, stop use and check in with your healthcare provider.
